rationale: EVER is sitting at 91.9% of today's range after a 10.8% gap-up on strong earnings, with price consolidating tightly near the session high ($29.16) in low-volume 1-minute candles — suggesting exhaustion rather than continuation. The risk/reward for a long is poor this late in the session with only 132 minutes remaining and price already extended well above VWAP ($28.10); a short against a strong earnings catalyst and positive market backdrop (SPY +0.58%, VIXY -2.06%) carries equal risk.
